about: Time-constant registry (#3686, defect class: one time constant, several semantic roles). Every time constant declared in server/ (ALL-CAPS const/let declarator ending in _MS/_SECONDS/_MINUTES/_HOURS/_DAYS or carrying a TTL/WINDOW marker) is registered here with its single semantic role and its boundary behaviour. Enforced by scripts/time-constants-check.mjs (wired into scripts/check.mjs, pinned by tests/time-constants.test.js): a PR that introduces an unregistered time constant in server/, reuses one constant in a second role, or leaves a stale row fails the gate. Existing constants are grandfathered as registered-with-current-roles; rows known to serve more than one role are marked multiRole and listed in the shrink-only multiRoleBaseline (the list may only shrink). This registry changes NO runtime semantics: contradictions between registered constants are recorded in knownConflicts and fixed by their own issues (#3592 wakeability, #3591 escrow), never by this gate.
seedMethod: Mechanical census at seedBase: declarator scan of server/** with the check's own name pattern (155 declaration lines, 157 declarators; the delta df2966d86..c4c9d39 changed only export keywords on already-censused rows). Boundary text records the declared semantics at the declaration site; grandfathered rows carry boundaryVerified=false where the lane did not re-probe the boundary in code.

manifestRow.name: Time-constant registry
manifestRow.enumerates: Every time constant declared in server/ (ALL-CAPS *_MS / *_SECONDS / *_MINUTES / *_HOURS / *_DAYS / *TTL* / *WINDOW* declarators), each with its single semantic role and boundary behaviour
manifestRow.sourceOfTruth: scripts/time-constants-registry.json (constants[] rows, diffed against the live server/ declarator scan by the closure check)
manifestRow.closureStatus: closed (live-set diff both directions: unregistered declaration fails, stale row fails, new multi-role row fails)
manifestRow.derivedOrHand: hand-seeded from the mechanical census at seedBase, census-checked
manifestRow.canary: tests/time-constants.test.js fixture canaries: an unregistered *_MS declaration fails, a stale row fails, an unmarked second role fails, a new multi-role row outside multiRoleBaseline fails; the real tree passes
manifestRow.lastFailure: none recorded in-tree as of 2026-10-24 (born with this registry, under #3686)

knownConflicts: WAKEABLE_WINDOW_MS (server/agent-heartbeats.mjs, 24h) vs MAX_CADENCE_SECONDS (same file, 7d): a healthy agent on a 48h cadence reads not-wakeable for half of every cycle. Registered, NOT fixed here — the fix is #3592's own.

Lease defaults disagree by surface: board claims default to DEFAULT_LEASE_HOURS=24h (server/work-claims.mjs), public-work claims default to 1h via a leaseHours parameter default in server/public-work-claims.mjs (not a named constant; see asRead), and First Shift policy assumes 8h (pinned explicitly as a workaround). Registered, NOT unified here.

Escrow deadlineMs (server/bounty-escrow.mjs) is a stored field, not a named constant, and serves claim-close + submission + implicit-review roles (#3591). Explicitly out of scope for this registry and its splits: money semantics, owned by the #3591 line.

asRead.reason: Stored per-bounty timestamp fields, not named time constants; the deadlineMs multi-role split is money semantics owned by #3591 and is deliberately not registered or touched here
A parameter default, not a named constant declaration, so the declarator scan cannot see it; recorded here because the lease-default divergence in knownConflicts turns on it
Registered in constants[] for completeness of the WINDOW marker, but its role is a result-count window, not a duration; rows like it carry unit 'count'

constants.name: MAX_UNDO_HOLD_MS
roles: maximum hold before a supervision action becomes un-undoable
constants.boundary: Requested holds above value are refused or clamped down to value.

constants.name: DONE_CARD_WINDOW_MS
roles: lookback window: only completions inside it are re-carded by supervision
constants.boundary: Completions younger than value may be re-carded; older ones are not.

constants.name: MAX_SNOOZE_MS
roles: maximum duration of a supervision snooze
constants.boundary: Requested snoozes above value are refused or clamped down to value.

constants.name: TYPING_TTL_MS
roles: lifetime of a typing indicator without refresh
constants.boundary: Indicator shows while refreshed within value; at age >= value it disappears.

constants.name: USAGE_DEFAULT_DAYS
roles: default lookback period, in days, for usage summaries
constants.boundary: Summary covers the trailing value days unless a period is requested.

constants.name: USAGE_MAX_DAYS
roles: maximum lookback period, in days, for usage summaries
constants.boundary: Requested periods above value are refused or clamped down to value.

constants.name: DAY_MS
roles: unit-conversion helper: milliseconds in one day, for usage summaries
constants.boundary: Not a threshold; a conversion factor only.

constants.name: DEFAULT_VETTING_MAX_AGE_MS
roles: maximum age of a vetting receipt still accepted as evidence
constants.boundary: Receipt is accepted while age < value; at age >= value it counts as stale evidence.

constants.name: DEFAULT_CLOCK_SKEW_MS
roles: clock-skew allowance when validating vetting receipt timestamps
constants.boundary: Timestamps within value of local time are accepted; beyond value they are refused as skewed.

constants.name: WAKE_STOCK_STALE_MS
roles: staleness threshold for wake-stock metrics snapshots
constants.boundary: Snapshot reads current while age < value; at age >= value it reads stale.

constants.name: WEB_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS
roles: timeout for one outbound web fetch
constants.boundary: Fetch is abandoned at value ms without a response.

constants.name: WEB_FETCH_DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_MS
roles: default maximum cache age accepted for a fetched page
constants.boundary: Cached copy is reused while age < value; at age >= value the page is refetched.

constants.name: WEB_FETCH_MAX_MAX_AGE_MS
roles: hard cap on the maximum cache age a fetch may request
constants.boundary: Requested max-ages above value are clamped down to value.

constants.name: WEB_FETCH_RATE_WINDOW_MS
roles: rate-limit window for outbound web fetches
constants.boundary: Fetches inside the trailing value-wide window count toward the cap; older fetches fall out.

constants.name: DEFAULT_TTL_SECONDS
roles: default push-message TTL handed to the push service (RFC 8030)
constants.boundary: Push service may deliver until value seconds pass; after that the message is dropped undelivered.

constants.name: MAX_VAPID_LIFETIME_SECONDS
roles: maximum lifetime of a VAPID authorisation token (RFC 8292)
constants.boundary: Tokens claiming a lifetime above value are invalid under the RFC and refused.

constants.name: WEB_RESEARCH_RATE_WINDOW_MS
roles: rate-limit window for web-research calls
constants.boundary: Calls inside the trailing value-wide window count toward the cap; older calls fall out.

constants.name: WEB_RESEARCH_DOCS_CACHE_TTL_MS
roles: cache lifetime for web-research documentation lookups
constants.boundary: Cached docs are reused while age < value; at age >= value they are refetched.

constants.name: REPLAY_TOLERANCE_MS
roles: timestamp tolerance for accepting a signed webhook (replay protection)
constants.boundary: Webhooks whose timestamp is within value of receipt are accepted; older/newer are refused as replays.

constants.name: DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_MS
roles: timeout for one webhook delivery attempt
constants.boundary: Attempt is abandoned at value ms and treated as a failed delivery.

constants.name: BACKOFF_BASE_MS
roles: base delay for webhook delivery retry backoff
constants.boundary: First retry waits value ms; later retries grow from this base up to BACKOFF_CAP_MS.

constants.name: BACKOFF_CAP_MS
roles: cap on webhook delivery retry backoff delay
constants.boundary: Computed backoff never exceeds value.

constants.name: CLAIM_EVENT_COALESCE_MS
roles: coalescing window for repeated claim events
constants.boundary: Events inside value of an identical event are coalesced into it; later ones emit anew.

constants.name: BOARD_LEASE_HOURS_MIN
roles: minimum lease duration for a board work claim
constants.boundary: Requested leases below value are refused or clamped up to value.

constants.name: BOARD_LEASE_HOURS_MAX
roles: maximum lease duration for a board work claim
constants.boundary: Requested leases above value are refused or clamped down to value.

constants.name: DEPLOY_STATUS_MAX_AGE_MS
roles: maximum age of a deploy-status record still trusted by claim integrity
constants.boundary: Status is trusted while age < value; at age >= value it must be re-read.

constants.name: DONE_WINDOW_MS
roles: lookback window in which a completion counts for claim-integrity checks
constants.boundary: Completions younger than value count; older completions fall out of the check.

constants.name: DEFAULT_LEASE_HOURS
roles: default lease duration for a board work claim when leaseHours is omitted
constants.boundary: A claim without leaseHours gets a lease expiring value hours after claim. DIVERGENCE (registered, not unified): public-work claims default to 1h and First Shift policy assumes 8h (see knownConflicts).

constants.name: MAX_LEASE_HOURS
roles: maximum lease duration for a board work claim
constants.boundary: Requested leases above value are refused or clamped down to value.

constants.name: STALE_UNCLAIMED_DAYS
roles: age after which an unclaimed board item reads stale
constants.boundary: Item reads fresh while unclaimed age < value days; at >= value it reads stale.

constants.name: FIRST_MATCH_MAX_MINUTES
roles: target maximum wait for a first matchmaking match
constants.boundary: A first match at or before value minutes meets the target; later misses it.

constants.name: WANTS_WORK_WINDOW_MS
roles: recency window in which a wants-work signal counts as live
constants.boundary: Signal counts while age < value; at age >= value it no longer matches work.
